theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months expenses, protecting you from unexpected financial shocks before investing.
caption: Smart money management starts with a foundation. Set aside emergency savings before pursuing growth goals. This provides security and peace of mind. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #MoneyManagement #FinancialWellness #SmartSaving
